name: MaxiNet
description: Extends Mininet to span network emulation across multiple physical machines using GRE tunnels for very large SDN network emulation.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker-based deployment for distributed Mininet emulation.

eval_notes: Scales Mininet across multiple machines. Good for large-scale SDN topology and distributed network management evals. Distributed Mininet for large-scale SDN emulation. Docker host support via containernet integration. Useful for evaluations requiring large-scale network topologies.
